points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 哈里·S·杜鲁门于1884年5月8日在密苏里州拉马尔出生，是约翰·安德森·杜鲁门和玛莎·艾伦·杜鲁门的第一个孩子。他的名字中间字母'S'没有具体含义，这是他父母双方名字首字母的组合。杜鲁门家庭经济状况不佳，父亲是一名牲畜和马匹商人，但经常失败。杜鲁门从小就展现出对阅读的浓厚兴趣，尤其喜爱历史和传记，这为他后来的政治生涯奠定了知识基础。
points.descriptionEn: Harry S. Truman was born on May 8, 1884, in Lamar, Missouri, to John Anderson Truman and Martha Ellen Truman. His middle initial 'S' doesn't stand for anything specific, but rather was chosen to honor both of his grandfathers, Anderson Shipp Truman and Solomon Young. The Truman family struggled financially, with his father working as a livestock and horse trader who often failed. Truman developed an early love for reading, particularly history and biographies, which would later form the intellectual foundation for his political career.

points.title: 商界奋斗
points.description: 杜鲁门高中毕业后，曾短暂就读于堪萨斯城法学院，但因家庭经济困难而辍学。他在独立城和堪萨斯城从事过多种工作，包括银行职员、铁路计时员和石油公司职员。1906年，他回到家族农场帮助父亲经营，直到1917年美国参加第一次世界大战。这段经历使杜鲁门了解了普通民众的生活困境，也培养了他坚韧不拔的性格和商业头脑，为他后来的政治决策提供了务实的基础。
points.descriptionEn: After graduating from high school, Truman briefly attended Kansas City Law School but dropped out due to financial difficulties. He held various jobs in Independence and Kansas City, including bank clerk, railroad timekeeper, and oil company clerk. In 1906, he returned to help his father run the family farm until 1917 when the United States entered World War I. These experiences gave Truman firsthand knowledge of ordinary people's struggles and developed his practical business acumen, which would later inform his political decisions.

points.title: 战场历练
points.description: 1917年，杜鲁门加入美国国民警卫队第129野战炮兵团，被派往法国参加第一次世界大战。他在法国战场上表现出色，担任炮兵连长，指挥部队参与了默兹-阿尔贡战役。这段军事经历极大地塑造了他的领导能力和决策风格，也让他深刻体会到战争的残酷和政治决策的重要性。战后，杜鲁门回到美国，被授予陆军少校军衔，这段经历成为他政治生涯的重要资本，也为他赢得了退伍军人组织的支持。
points.descriptionEn: In 1917, Truman joined the Missouri National Guard's 129th Field Artillery Regiment and was deployed to France for World War I. He distinguished himself in combat, serving as a battery commander and leading his troops in the Meuse-Argonne offensive. This military experience profoundly shaped his leadership style and decision-making process, giving him firsthand understanding of war's brutality and the importance of political decisions. After the war, Truman was promoted to major in the Army Reserve, and this experience became a valuable asset in his political career, earning him support from veteran organizations.

points.title: 国会生涯
points.description: 1934年，杜鲁门当选为密苏里州参议员，开始了他在国会的政治生涯。他最初支持罗斯福新政，但后来因政府腐败问题与罗斯福产生分歧。1941年，他领导了著名的'杜鲁门委员会'，调查国防合同中的浪费和腐败问题，为国家节省了大量资金。这一成就使他声名鹊起，1944年被罗斯福选为副总统候选人。1945年罗斯福去世后，杜鲁门继任美国总统，开始了他的总统任期。在国会期间，杜鲁门建立了广泛的跨党派关系，这为他后来的总统工作提供了重要支持。
points.descriptionEn: In 1934, Truman was elected as a U.S. Senator from Missouri, beginning his political career in Congress. Initially a supporter of Franklin D. Roosevelt's New Deal, he later grew disillusioned with government corruption and clashed with the administration. In 1941, he led the famous 'Truman Committee' to investigate waste and corruption in defense contracts, saving the government substantial funds. This achievement brought him national recognition, leading to his selection as FDR's running mate in 1944. After Roosevelt's death in 1945, Truman became President. His Senate career allowed him to build extensive bipartisan relationships that would support his later presidential work.

points.title: 总统任期
points.description: 杜鲁门担任总统期间面临诸多重大挑战：他决定在广岛和长崎使用原子弹，加速了二战结束；实施杜鲁门主义，遏制共产主义扩张；推动马歇尔计划，帮助欧洲战后重建；建立北大西洋公约组织(NATO)；发起公平就业措施，推动民权运动；以及介入朝鲜战争。这些决策塑造了战后国际秩序，确立了美国作为超级大国的地位。杜鲁门还实施了'忠诚计划'，调查政府中的共产党员，引发了国内争议。他的'公平施政'议程虽然未能完全实现，但为后来的民权立法奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: During his presidency, Truman faced numerous challenges: he authorized the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, accelerating the end of WWII; implemented the Truman Doctrine to contain communism; pushed the Marshall Plan to rebuild post-war Europe; established NATO; initiated fair employment practices, advancing the civil rights movement; and intervened in the Korean War. These decisions shaped the post-war international order and established the United States as a superpower. Truman also implemented the 'Loyalty Program' to investigate communists in government, causing domestic controversy. His 'Fair Deal' agenda, though not fully realized, laid the groundwork for later civil rights legislation.

supporter.zh: 杜鲁门被视为一位果断、务实的领导人，他在关键时刻展现了非凡的勇气和决断力。支持者赞扬他结束二战的决策、推动马歇尔计划重建欧洲、建立北约以维护西方民主，以及开启民权运动的努力。杜鲁门主义成为美国冷战外交的基石，他的领导帮助美国从战时经济平稳过渡到和平时期，奠定了战后国际秩序的基础。他常被形容为'来自密苏里的普通人'，代表了普通美国人的价值观和常识。
supporter.en: Truman is regarded as a decisive and pragmatic leader who demonstrated extraordinary courage and judgment at critical moments. Supporters praise his decision to end WWII, his advocacy for the Marshall Plan to rebuild Europe, his establishment of NATO to defend Western democracy, and his efforts to advance civil rights. The Truman Doctrine became the cornerstone of American Cold War diplomacy, and his leadership helped the U.S. transition smoothly from wartime to peacetime economy, establishing the foundation for the post-war international order. He is often described as 'the man from Missouri,' representing the values and common sense of ordinary Americans.

critic.zh: 批评者认为杜鲁门在重大决策上过于草率，尤其是使用原子弹的决定，造成大量平民伤亡。朝鲜战争的介入被批评为军事上的失误，导致长期冲突和巨大人员损失。'忠诚计划'被指责为侵犯公民自由，引发了国内政治迫害的担忧。杜鲁门的经济政策也受到批评，通胀上升和工资管制引发民众不满。此外，他对麦卡锡主义的态度暧昧，被认为未能有效遏制国内政治迫害的蔓延。这些争议使他的历史评价复杂化，成为美国历史上最具争议的总统之一。
critic.en: Critics argue that Truman made hasty decisions on major issues, particularly the use of atomic bombs which resulted in massive civilian casualties. The intervention in the Korean War is criticized as a military mistake that led to prolonged conflict and significant human losses. The 'Loyalty Program' is condemned as an infringement on civil liberties, raising concerns about domestic political persecution. Truman's economic policies also faced criticism, with rising inflation and wage controls causing public discontent. Additionally, his ambiguous stance toward McCarthyism is seen as failing to effectively curb the spread of domestic political persecution. These controversies complicate his historical legacy, making him one of the most controversial presidents in American history.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为杜鲁门是一位转型时期的总统，他面临了从二战到冷战的重大历史转折。他的决策塑造了战后世界格局，影响延续至今。在流行文化中，杜鲁门常被塑造成一个普通人的代表，他的'责任到此为止'的座右铭广为人知。历史评价趋向于承认他的复杂性和矛盾性：既是一位有远见的国际战略家，也是一位在国内政策上存在局限的领导人。他的遗产体现了美国在战后崛起为超级大国的过程，以及随之而来的全球责任与道德困境。
objective.en: Historians generally view Truman as a transitional president who navigated the critical shift from WWII to the Cold War. His decisions shaped the post-war global landscape with effects that continue today. In popular culture, Truman is often portrayed as an ordinary man, with his 'The buck stops here' motto being widely recognized. Historical assessments tend to acknowledge his complexity and contradictions: both a visionary international strategist and a leader with limitations in domestic policy. His legacy embodies America's emergence as a superpower after the war and the accompanying global responsibilities and moral dilemmas.

others.zh: 杜鲁门是美国历史上最被低估的总统之一，他做出了艰难但必要的决定，塑造了我们今天生活的世界。
others.en: Truman is one of the most underrated presidents in American history; he made difficult but necessary decisions that shaped the world we live in today.
